title: 電流感測與保護電路
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討分流、磁性感測、量測誤差與快速保護，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore shunts, magnetic sensing, measurement errors and fast protection, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。感測器頻寬或量測精度不代表保護已足夠；隔離、過載和故障切離需獨立證據，不提供實機故障注入指令。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Sensor bandwidth/accuracy does not establish sufficient protection; isolation, overload and interruption need independent evidence, without physical fault-injection instructions.

stages.title: 感測與範圍
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成感測與範圍；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete sensing and ranges through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 比較分流與磁性感測：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Compare shunt and magnetic sensing: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解比較分流與磁性感測，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand compare shunt and magnetic sensing through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 用同一電流範圍比較插入損耗、DC 能力和隔離需求。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: At equal range compare insertion loss, DC capability and isolation requirements. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 用同一電流範圍比較插入損耗、DC 能力和隔離需求。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: At equal range compare insertion loss, DC capability and isolation requirements. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「比較分流與磁性感測」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把分流、磁性感測、量測誤差與快速保護的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare shunt and magnetic sensing disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of shunts, magnetic sensing, measurement errors and fast protection behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「比較分流與磁性感測」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for compare shunt and magnetic sensing, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 比較分流與磁性感測：原理
knowledge.titleEn: Compare shunt and magnetic sensing: principle
knowledge.text: 分流直接量電阻壓降，Hall/磁通技術透過磁場，各有隔離與偏移權衡。
knowledge.textEn: Shunts measure resistive drop; Hall/flux technologies sense fields, with isolation/offset tradeoffs.

knowledge.title: 比較分流與磁性感測：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Compare shunt and magnetic sensing: evidence
knowledge.text: 用同一電流範圍比較插入損耗、DC 能力和隔離需求。
knowledge.textEn: At equal range compare insertion loss, DC capability and isolation requirements.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：Rshunt=1 mΩ、I=50 A，壓降 50 mV、耗散 I²R=2.5 W。若增益 20 V/V，輸出訊號增量 1 V；輸入偏移 25 μV 相當於 25 mA 電流誤差，不包含增益、溫漂和 ADC 誤差。 感測器頻寬或量測精度不代表保護已足夠；隔離、過載和故障切離需獨立證據，不提供實機故障注入指令。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 1 mΩ shunt at 50 A drops 50 mV and dissipates I²R=2.5 W. Gain 20 V/V yields a 1 V signal increment. A 25 μV input offset equals 25 mA current error, excluding gain, drift and ADC errors. Sensor bandwidth/accuracy does not establish sufficient protection; isolation, overload and interruption need independent evidence, without physical fault-injection instructions.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 1 mΩ shunt at 50 A drops 50 mV and dissipates I²R=2.5 W. Gain 20 V/V yields a 1 V signal increment. A 25 μV input offset equals 25 mA current error, excluding gain, drift and ADC errors. Sensor bandwidth/accuracy does not establish sufficient protection; isolation, overload and interruption need independent evidence, without physical fault-injection instructions.
